scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberate colorblind-safe palette and multi-layer composition (swarm + box plot + callouts) show real design intent, but percentile labels share the same y-position as the subtitle and visibly overlap it, and the top-earner leader lines converge into a cramped, tangled cluster on the right side.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Log scale is correct for right-skewed income data, box plot uses proper Tukey fences and data-driven quantiles, dots encode identity not magnitude so no area-scaling violation — but xScale domain is hardcoded [14000,550000] rather than derived from data, making it brittle under the scaling and subset metamorphic relations.
scores.stress_test_note: Fully static chart with no brush, zoom, or transitions; pointer-event-based tooltips avoid mouse-touch fights and incur only cheap CSS style mutations on pointermove — no interaction robustness violations found.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Single view, 4-color Tol palette, pre-computed static swarm with 400 dots reads cleanly as a distribution; minor crowding in the 5 top-earner callouts (one label truncated at right edge) and subtitle text collides with P25/P50 percentile labels, but neither impairs the main income-by-education pattern.

proposer: Removed unused `rNorm` variable and eliminated redundant quantile recomputation by reusing `percentileVals` from the percentile lines section. The `Float64Array.from(incomes)` wrapper was also unnecessary since `incomes` is already sorted. Net: -3 lines (253 lines).
